headline: Chest-high-ish SSE on a good angle but wind fights you all day.
today: Best swell angle of the three spots today and pushing to 3ft on the sets, but the wind is cross-on early and full onshore by afternoon climbing to 15mph. Your window is dawn to mid-morning on the incoming — glassy it won't be, but it's the cleanest it gets. Fish or groveler to make the short-period stuff work.

daysToWatch.note: A touch more period (near 6.7s) on the good S angle early before the cross turns onshore. Dawn is the play.
NW offshore/cross-off in the morning makes it clean, but size drops to knee-to-waist. Small and pretty if you want a mellow log.
